Smriti Irani to Visit Haryana for BJP Organizational Meetings

Former Union Minister Smriti Irani is scheduled to visit Haryana on October 25 for a two-day stay. She will hold marathon meetings as the new state in-charge for the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). During her visit, she is expected to review the work of ministers and assess the organization's activeness.
